name: orders_backlog_recovered
incident_summary: Post-mitigation snapshot of the orders_backlog incident: deploy #7788 was rolled back and the orders-worker Redis ConnectionPool was pinned back to 25. Telemetry shows the p99 spike draining back to its pre-incident baseline across checkout-api and orders-worker.
_note: Companion to orders_backlog.json. This is the SAME incident, read AFTER the rollback of #7788. The metric series carry the full arc — pre-incident baseline, the spike, and the return to baseline — so RecoveryWatcher.assess() reports recovery (peak >= baseline*degraded_ratio, latest <= baseline*recovered_ratio). Point the recovery watch at this scenario with RECOVERY__SCENARIO=orders_backlog_recovered so a post-mitigation poll records a metrics-sourced 'Recovery observed' timeline entry instead of the operator narrating it by hand.

logs.text: connection pool restored to 25; 0 threads waiting, queue drained to 0 jobs
redis-rb rolled back to 4.8 (deploy #7788 reverted); ConnectionPool size 5 -> 25
order_confirmation enqueue latency back under 40ms; success rate 98.6%
